questions.prompt:
Statements:
(a) All crows are pigeons.
(b) All pigeons are hens.
Conclusions:
(I) Some hens are pigeons.
(II) All pigeons are crows.
Take the statements as true. Which conclusions follow?

options.A: I is correct and II is wrong
options.B: Both I and II are wrong
options.C: Both I and II are correct
options.D: I is wrong and II is correct

questions.rule: Draw the groups as circles in every way the statements allow. A conclusion follows only if it is true in every drawing.
questions.working: Pigeons are inside hens, so some hens are pigeons. Crows are inside pigeons, but some pigeons may not be crows, so II does not follow.

questions.rule: Every 7 days the weekday comes back round.
questions.working: 408 = 58 × 7 + 2, so Sunday + 2 = Tuesday

questions.prompt: Find how the numbers in the figures are related, and find the missing number.
questions.rule: In each box, the 1st × the 3rd ÷ the 2nd = the 4th: 12 × 6 ÷ 18 = 4, 14 × 7 ÷ 49 = 2.

questions.prompt: Find how the numbers in the figures are related, and find the missing number.
questions.rule: Take the square roots of the corners. The middle is the top root × (the left root − the right root): 10 × (11 − 8) = 30, 11 × (16 − 14) = 22.

questions.prompt: Find how the numbers in the figures are related, and find the missing number.
questions.rule: Top × bottom − left × right = the middle number squared: 12 × 6 − 8 × 7 = 16 = 4², 9 × 5 − 10 × 2 = 25 = 5².

questions.prompt: Two different positions of the same dice are given below. Identify the right pair of opposite faces.
questions.rule: A face cannot be opposite a face seen next to it.
questions.working: A is seen next to C, D, E and F, so A is opposite B. Only A has the pair (A, B); B and C pair A with faces seen next to it, and D pairs it with C.

questions.prompt: Identify the correct dice for the given figure.
questions.rule: Fold the staircase net: a and d, b and e, and c and f end up opposite each other.
questions.working: A shows a with d, B shows b with e and D shows c with f, which cannot happen. Only C (d, e and f) can.

questions.prompt: 3 different positions of the same dice are given. The face opposite to the face having 2 dots is
questions.rule: A face cannot be opposite a face seen next to it.
questions.working: The 2 is seen next to 5, 1, 3 and 4, so the face opposite 2 is the one left over: 6.
